source_state: Working tree based on baseline_commit with uncommitted decoder and C ABI changes: the decoder is generic over its output sink (initialized or uninitialized slice) instead of matching an enum, decompress_to_uninit copies a complete stored member straight from the input, and mbrotli-ffi zeroes affordable destinations to use the initialized paths. The ring-growth bound fix in the fast command loop (reach!) was made after this sweep; callgrind shows it changes executed instructions by at most 0.03% on the decoder harness. Encoder sources unchanged from baseline_commit.

Fixed encoder order; confidence bounds describe sampling variation, not all environmental bias.
Cold native APIs; retained workspace and streaming are measured by the root benchmarks.

Eight benchmark processes ran at once on separate cores and shared the last-level cache, memory bandwidth and the package's turbo budget. Every implementation, Google C included, measured 3-10% slower in absolute terms than the single-core 2026-09-26 sweep; ratios to C moved far less. Latency cases of tens of nanoseconds (empty input) are the most affected.
Builds of fuzz targets and profiling harnesses ran on logical CPUs 16-23 during part of the sweep.
